latest.title: Stacked courses no longer freeze
latest.notes: The mod wrote its FSM variables (ModQ1-3, ModSectionDelay) into every heap object that referenced the variable name, 21 of 22 of them not variables; candidates are now filtered by object header and class, which ends the abort(218) runtime freezes after lap spawn bursts with stacked courses and after game over.

versions.title: Stacked courses, instant restart, music, rainbow
versions.notes: Before track shaping: Courses, R restart, music, rainbow, ad-free scene.

versions.title: Gravity modes (curves and ramps)
versions.notes: Sideways-gravity curves and airborne ramp effects, before the course itself was reshaped.

versions.title: Track shaping with rigid blocks
versions.notes: Curves and 90-degree twists built one 14-unit block at a time; the last version before the three-slab geometry. Score/speed-up trigger boxes repaired on 2026-10-22 (they missed the ball in every build since the spawner patch).

versions.title: Three-slab geometry (first build)
versions.notes: Lane blocks as three slabs with per-slab roll. Known bad: slabs sat one slab late (lane ends 9.4 short of each jump/drop) and the score triggers missed the ball (no score, void after the start tunnel).

versions.title: Section-start wrap, version picker, stack on straight only
versions.notes: Added the two extra slabs at each section start and the Version selector. Known bad: lane still ended 9.4 short at section ends; score triggers still missed the ball.

versions.title: Forward slab placement, score triggers repaired
versions.notes: Slabs cover the block ahead of the spawn point (vanilla spans), score/speed-up triggers hit the ball again. Last incremental-roll geometry before the continuous roll rework.

versions.title: Compressed data bundle, loader cache
versions.notes: Same play as v9-forward; the scene bundle is gzip-compressed and the loader keeps the build in IndexedDB. Known bad: stacked courses (and the game-over screen) could abort the runtime (abort(218)) a few seconds after a lap spawn burst or a death, from the mod's stray heap writes; fixed in the next version.
